description: Puts your translation of a design’s words in (Ukrainian ⇄ English ⇄ Polish), keeping each text’s style, and swaps a face that lacks the language’s letters for one that has them. YOU translate: get_design gives the text layers’ ids and words; pass each translated. Use it for «translate it into Ukrainian». To keep the original, resize_design or make_variants first and translate the copy. Example: { design, to: «uk», texts: [{ layer: «l…», text: «Відкриття» }] }.

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

texts.description: your translation of each text layer { layer: its id from get_design, text }; e.g. [{ "layer": "t1", "text": "Відкриття" }]

name: translate_design
title: Translate
